limitation: Five predeclared matched cycles at count eight, depth six, with identical retained wallet fixtures and fixed per-GPU limits. Each arm applies the same six user transactions and two issuance transactions to its own isolated height-10 journal. There are no fresh wallet proofs and no sustained transaction campaign. Pipeline time includes candidate preparation, staged prefix work, final proving, CPU audit, native application and controller cleanup. Arrival submission, wallet proof generation and separate replay checks are excluded. Exact seal intervals are retained; controller exit is an upper bound on host-ready time. These results qualify the frozen binary and count-eight geometry only. The experimental denominator cache, larger shared counts, the cold full-64 and complete post-seal contract boundaries, full-size CPU proving, returned Mac repetitions and the two-hour pilot remain pending.
